title: ValeSMP
description: fun vanilla, smp inspired by hermitcraft and adapted for use on a public scale!
body:
We started **ValeSMP** back in mid 2025, to try bridge that gap where me, and a group of friends kept hopping servers. We are still yet to do a server reset, and don't plan on it any time soon! We have pretty relaxed rules, no power hungry admins, no cheaters, and most importantly good hardware to back it all up. 

We've still (touch wood) not dropped below 20 TPS, keep a close eye and have regular backups incase. We want this to be a forever server, if possible. But we keep in touch with the community, and make sure we listen!

It's kept up to date, has some custom plugins, a pretty cool resource pack (i may be biased) and more. 

Check us out at www.valesmp.com or alternatively, join our discord and apply today :D
